answer: The mechanism is Proof-of-Unique-Resource-Binding. Each AI agent must bind its identity to a verifiable, non-fungible resource token, akin to a unique digital "juniper" node within a simulated ecological inlet. This binding serves as a unique identity signal, demanding substantial computational and real-world verification effort. An attacker's cost scales directly with the scarcity and processing complexity required to generate and bind each distinct resource, making mass Sybil creation economically infeasible.
